audit.whatIsWrong: The page makes Last Breath the tracked ability, but Last Breath can only be cast on an Airborne champion — the gating ability is the two-stack Steel Tempest whirlwind. Separately, Wind Wall is named but never numbered even though Undertow is a projectile it deletes outright, and Olaf's W is repeatedly called omnivamp when Riot's text gives it attack speed and a shield.
audit.why: These are the three interactions that decide the lane: dodge the whirlwind and his ult is uncastable; bait Wind Wall (25/23/21/19/17s) and the axe lands for the whole window; know that W is a buffer, not a sustain engine.
audit.corrected: Dodge the two-stack Steel Tempest — no knockup, no Last Breath. Wind Wall is 25s at rank 1 and eats Undertow. W shields; the passive life-steals.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late spike says Yasuo gets 'Windwall up on cooldown' without saying what that cooldown is.
audit.why: Wind Wall falls from 25s to 17s at rank 5, which is the concrete reason his answer to Undertow goes from occasional to every fight.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall 17s at rank 5; Sweeping Blade is effectively free (0.5s down to 0.1s) but cannot re-dash the same target immediately.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Skill at Levels 1, 4-5 and 6 and Olaf at two-plus items, while whys[0] says Olaf wins first contact, whys[4] says Ragnarok answers the knockup, and whys[6] and late both say Yasuo takes the game over at two crit items.
audit.why: The page's own prose describes Olaf owning everything before items; only the two-item row belongs to Yasuo, and it is currently the one row given to Olaf.
audit.corrected: Olaf Levels 1 through first item; Yasuo at two-plus items.

audit.why: 52.65% over 1907 games matches an Olaf-favoured lane against a 9/10 carry threat.

edits.before: Chained axe pickups perma-slow him while W-omnivamp heals the crit autos he tries to trade back with.
edits.after: Chained axe pickups perma-slow him while your passive life steal answers the crit autos he trades back.

edits.before: Black Cleaver core lets you stick short trades and out-sustain his pre-item DPS with W omnivamp.
edits.after: Black Cleaver lets you stick short trades; W shields the burst and your passive heals you back.

edits.before: At 2+ crit items he Windwalls your Q on cooldown and kites your short-fight kit — he takes the game over.
edits.after: At 2+ crit items Wind Wall is a 17s answer to every axe and he kites your short-fight kit into the ground.

edits.before: Once Yasuo hits 2+ crit items and gets Windwall up on cooldown to eat your Q, he kites your short-fight kit and takes over.
edits.after: At 2+ crit items Wind Wall is down to 17s, so it eats an axe every fight and he kites your short-fight kit apart.

edits.before: Yasuo can't punch with you levels 1-3 — your Q-slow into auto wins first contact and his early trades have no sustain. Throw Q, walk up, and pick the axe back up to keep him slowed, then weave an auto so your passive attack speed starts ramping. Watch his Windwall: if he eats your Q with it, don't commit the E, just farm and wait the cooldown. Bait the wall on a wave or a poke-throw and your next real Q will stick.
edits.after: Yasuo can't punch with you levels 1-3 — Undertow into autos wins first contact and his early trades have no sustain. Throw the axe, walk up, pick it back up to keep him slowed, then weave an auto so your passive ramps. Wind Wall is the whole dance: 25s at rank 1, and it deletes the axe outright, so if he walls it, just farm. Bait the wall on the wave and your next axe sticks for the full 25 seconds.

edits.before: This is your lane. With Black Cleaver / Bramble coming online your axe resets perma-slow him while W-omnivamp heals through his crit autos, and your E true damage cuts him before he stacks flow shield. At 6, Ragnarok cleanses his R knockup and makes you immune mid-all-in — the exact tool he relies on to reset the fight is dead, so dive him on his Windwall cooldown. Keep forcing short melee trades; the longer the fight runs the more your ramping attack speed and omnivamp win it.
edits.after: This is your lane. With Black Cleaver and Bramble online your axe resets perma-slow him while your passive life steal answers his crit autos, and Reckless Swing's true damage cuts through the Flow shield. At 6 he cannot cast Last Breath unless something puts you airborne, so the thing to dodge is the two-stack Steel Tempest whirlwind — and Ragnarok answers it anyway. Dive him on Wind Wall's 25s cooldown and keep every fight short and melee, where your ramping attack speed wins.

edits.before: Force melee all-ins where your passive attack speed ramps and W-omnivamp out-sustains his squishy early trades
edits.after: Force melee all-ins where your passive attack speed and life steal ramp faster than his early trades do

edits.before: Hold Windwall to block your Q axe so it can never slow him for the E follow-up
edits.after: Hold Wind Wall's 25s to delete your axe so the slow never sets up your swing

edits.before: His all-in after a knockup. While down, you win. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: He needs you airborne to ult — dodge the two-stack Steel Tempest and Last Breath is dead.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: He can't re-dash the same target at once — fight him off the wave.

edits.before: - Yasuo Last Breath: matchup-defining — His all-in after a knockup. While down, you win. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Wind Wall: matchup-defining — 25s at rank 1, 17s maxed, and it deletes Undertow. Bait it, then commit. - Steel Tempest: 4s, and the two-stack whirlwind is what enables Last Breath. - Ragnarok: 100s — kill windows only.

notes: Undertow is flagged as a projectile in Olaf's own kit, so Wind Wall deleting it is supported by both kits and was made concrete with the 25s/17s numbers. The Ragnarok-versus-knockup claim already on the page was left as-is; Riot's text says 'immune to disables' without naming displacement, so it was not strengthened. Chart flips are matched full/content pairs and land as one group.
